'''''Droid in Contrast''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It depicted a [[FX-series medical assistant droid/Legends|FX-series]] [[Medical droid/Legends|medical assistant droid]] and its look suggested it was created by an [[Artist/Legends|artist]] attempting to learn a new style. The [[Color/Legends|color]] choices of light blue and white were unique and made the painting almost unbearable to look at.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Droid in Contrast'' was a painting available to players of the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG" /> which was released on [[June 26]], [[2003]]<ref name="Start">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news20030617.html|text=''Galaxies'' to Release June 26}}</ref> and shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> It could be obtained by looting a picture printer and various other items from enemies within the game. Once collected, the player could combine the items and get a random painting. The other paintings players could receive were ''[[Bio-Engineer Poster]]'' and ''[[Double Helix]]''. The player could use the painting as decoration for their home.<ref name="SWG" />
